content.subject: PR-4a: Standardize 5 games on GameLayout
content.description:
Implement Plan v3 PR-4a (lines ~187-189). Migrate ColorBlocksGame, JellyVolleyball, Snake, Sudoku, Tetris from their inline headers to the existing `<GameLayout>` shared shell.

CONTEXT: 8 of 13 games already use `<GameLayout>`. 5 bypass it. Each carries an inline re-implementation of header, home button, pause toggle, status text — ~30 LOC of duplication per game. Migrating swaps that for ~5 LOC `<GameLayout>` invocation each. Net code-LOC reduction.

ACTIONS:
1. Read src/components/shared/GameLayout.tsx to understand the prop contract.
2. For EACH of the 5 games (ColorBlocksGame, JellyVolleyball, Snake, Sudoku, Tetris), rewrite the Page.tsx file:
   - Replace the inline header div with `<GameLayout title="..." onNavigateHome={onNavigateHome} headerActions={<>...</>}>` wrapper.
   - Move any pause/restart/settings buttons into the `headerActions` slot.
   - Preserve all existing behavior (status messages, game state, key handling).
3. Take BEFORE/AFTER screenshots of each game (use any reasonable method — Playwright screenshot in a script, or describe the visual diff in commit message if no headless rendering available). Mention in PR description.

ACCEPTANCE:
- `grep -L 'GameLayout' src/components/Games/*/[A-Z]*Page.tsx` returns EMPTY (every game uses it). Currently 5 are listed; should be 0 after.
- ALL existing tests still pass (no regression in game logic)
- Per-PR gate green: lint, type-check, test --run, test:games, test:touch, playwright, build
- Playwright e2e: all 14 tiles (including the 5 migrated games) still navigate cleanly

content.subject: PR-4c1: usePopBalloons useReducer refactor
content.description:
Implement Plan v3 PR-4c1 (lines ~196-198). Collapse 11 separate useState calls in usePopBalloons into one useReducer. BLOCKED BY #9 (PR-4a) — PR-4a may change PopBalloonsPage.tsx structure indirectly.

ACTIONS:
1. Read src/hooks/usePopBalloons.ts. Identify the 11 useState calls (score, combo, maxCombo, lives, timeRemaining, balloons, etc.).
2. Design a discriminated-union action type: `BalloonAction = {type: 'pop', balloonId: string} | {type: 'tick'} | {type: 'spawn', balloon: Balloon} | {type: 'reset'} | {type: 'combo'} | ...`
3. Implement reducer function: `(state, action) => state` — pure, deterministic.
4. Replace the 11 useStates with one useReducer.
5. All existing handlers (handleBalloonPop, handleTick, etc.) become dispatch calls.

ACCEPTANCE:

- The hook's public API stays IDENTICAL (consumers shouldn't notice)

- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-4c2: useBubblePop rAF fix
content.description:
Implement Plan v3 PR-4c2 (lines ~199-201). BLOCKED BY #9.

PROBLEM (from audit Q4): useBubblePop calls setGameState TWICE per rAF frame (one to spawn bubble, one to move bubbles). Second call sees pre-frame state. Plus `useEffect` dep on `gameState.bubbles.length` tears down/recreates the rAF loop on every spawn.

ACTIONS:
1. Merge the two setGameState calls into ONE functional update: `setGameState(prev => ({...prev, bubbles: [...prev.bubbles.map(move).filter(stillOnScreen), maybeSpawn()].slice(-MAX)}))`
2. Remove `gameState.bubbles.length` from the useEffect dep array. Use a ref to read latest bubbles without re-running effect.
3. Confirm the rAF loop only sets up ONCE per mount.

ACCEPTANCE:
- NEW test file: src/hooks/useBubblePop.test.ts with `vi.useFakeTimers` simulating 1 second of game time. Assert setGameState was called ~60 times (with tolerance ±10), NOT ~120.
- BubblePop gameplay behaves identically (manual: bubbles spawn, move, pop animations work)
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 4 PR-4c2: useBubblePop rAF — single setGameState/frame, stable loop"

content.subject: PR-4c3: setTimeout chain cleanup (useSimonSays + useBubblePop)
content.description:
Implement Plan v3 PR-4c3 (lines ~202-204). BLOCKED BY #12 (PR-4c2) since both touch useBubblePop.

PROBLEM (audit Q4): useSimonSays.showSequence has nested 3-level setTimeout chain — only outermost is tracked; inner setTimeouts leak on unmount. useBubblePop.popBubble fires a 500ms setTimeout with no cleanup.

1. Read src/hooks/useSimonSays.ts and find showSequence function. Track ALL setTimeout IDs in an array ref.
2. In useEffect cleanup, clear every tracked ID with clearTimeout.
3. Same for src/hooks/useBubblePop.ts popBubble setTimeout.

ACCEPTANCE:
- NEW tests in useSimonSays.test.ts (or new file) + useBubblePop.test.ts (extension of 4c2): mount-unmount with `vi.useFakeTimers`, assert no warnings about state updates on unmounted component
- Per-PR gate green
- No new console warnings during normal play

content.subject: PR-4a: Standardize 5 games on GameLayout
content.description:
Implement Plan v3 PR-4a (lines ~187-189). Migrate ColorBlocksGame, JellyVolleyball, Snake, Sudoku, Tetris from their inline headers to the existing `<GameLayout>` shared shell.

CONTEXT: 8 of 13 games already use `<GameLayout>`. 5 bypass it. Each carries an inline re-implementation of header, home button, pause toggle, status text — ~30 LOC of duplication per game. Migrating swaps that for ~5 LOC `<GameLayout>` invocation each. Net code-LOC reduction.

ACTIONS:
1. Read src/components/shared/GameLayout.tsx to understand the prop contract.
2. For EACH of the 5 games (ColorBlocksGame, JellyVolleyball, Snake, Sudoku, Tetris), rewrite the Page.tsx file:
   - Replace the inline header div with `<GameLayout title="..." onNavigateHome={onNavigateHome} headerActions={<>...</>}>` wrapper.
   - Move any pause/restart/settings buttons into the `headerActions` slot.
   - Preserve all existing behavior (status messages, game state, key handling).
3. Take BEFORE/AFTER screenshots of each game (use any reasonable method — Playwright screenshot in a script, or describe the visual diff in commit message if no headless rendering available). Mention in PR description.

ACCEPTANCE:
- `grep -L 'GameLayout' src/components/Games/*/[A-Z]*Page.tsx` returns EMPTY (every game uses it). Currently 5 are listed; should be 0 after.
- ALL existing tests still pass (no regression in game logic)
- Per-PR gate green: lint, type-check, test --run, test:games, test:touch, playwright, build
- Playwright e2e: all 14 tiles (including the 5 migrated games) still navigate cleanly

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 4 PR-4a: standardize 5 games on GameLayout shell"

When done, SendMessage team-lead with: commit SHA, 5 games migrated, LOC delta (insertions/deletions), gate results.

This PR is HIGH BLAST-RADIUS — touches 5 games' top-level structure. If visual regressions appear, mark task in_progress and report BEFORE pressing on.

content.subject: PR-4c1: usePopBalloons useReducer refactor
content.description:
Implement Plan v3 PR-4c1 (lines ~196-198). Collapse 11 separate useState calls in usePopBalloons into one useReducer. BLOCKED BY #9 (PR-4a) — PR-4a may change PopBalloonsPage.tsx structure indirectly.

ACTIONS:
1. Read src/hooks/usePopBalloons.ts. Identify the 11 useState calls (score, combo, maxCombo, lives, timeRemaining, balloons, etc.).
2. Design a discriminated-union action type: `BalloonAction = {type: 'pop', balloonId: string} | {type: 'tick'} | {type: 'spawn', balloon: Balloon} | {type: 'reset'} | {type: 'combo'} | ...`
3. Implement reducer function: `(state, action) => state` — pure, deterministic.
4. Replace the 11 useStates with one useReducer.
5. All existing handlers (handleBalloonPop, handleTick, etc.) become dispatch calls.

ACCEPTANCE:
- NEW test file: src/hooks/usePopBalloons.reducer.test.ts with ≥10 test cases (one per action type, including edge cases like pop-when-no-balloons)
- The hook's public API stays IDENTICAL (consumers shouldn't notice)
- PopBalloons gameplay behaves identically (manual: play a round, score/combo/lives all work)
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-4c2: useBubblePop rAF fix
content.description:
Implement Plan v3 PR-4c2 (lines ~199-201). BLOCKED BY #9.

PROBLEM (from audit Q4): useBubblePop calls setGameState TWICE per rAF frame (one to spawn bubble, one to move bubbles). Second call sees pre-frame state. Plus `useEffect` dep on `gameState.bubbles.length` tears down/recreates the rAF loop on every spawn.

ACTIONS:
1. Merge the two setGameState calls into ONE functional update: `setGameState(prev => ({...prev, bubbles: [...prev.bubbles.map(move).filter(stillOnScreen), maybeSpawn()].slice(-MAX)}))`
2. Remove `gameState.bubbles.length` from the useEffect dep array. Use a ref to read latest bubbles without re-running effect.
3. Confirm the rAF loop only sets up ONCE per mount.

ACCEPTANCE:
- NEW test file: src/hooks/useBubblePop.test.ts with `vi.useFakeTimers` simulating 1 second of game time. Assert setGameState was called ~60 times (with tolerance ±10), NOT ~120.
- BubblePop gameplay behaves identically (manual: bubbles spawn, move, pop animations work)
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 4 PR-4c2: useBubblePop rAF — single setGameState/frame, stable loop"

content.subject: PR-4c3: setTimeout chain cleanup (useSimonSays + useBubblePop)
content.description:
Implement Plan v3 PR-4c3 (lines ~202-204). BLOCKED BY #12 (PR-4c2) since both touch useBubblePop.

PROBLEM (audit Q4): useSimonSays.showSequence has nested 3-level setTimeout chain — only outermost is tracked; inner setTimeouts leak on unmount. useBubblePop.popBubble fires a 500ms setTimeout with no cleanup.

ACTIONS:
1. Read src/hooks/useSimonSays.ts and find showSequence function. Track ALL setTimeout IDs in an array ref.
2. In useEffect cleanup, clear every tracked ID with clearTimeout.
3. Same for src/hooks/useBubblePop.ts popBubble setTimeout.

ACCEPTANCE:
- NEW tests in useSimonSays.test.ts (or new file) + useBubblePop.test.ts (extension of 4c2): mount-unmount with `vi.useFakeTimers`, assert no warnings about state updates on unmounted component
- Per-PR gate green
- No new console warnings during normal play

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 4 PR-4c3: cleanup leaked setTimeouts in useSimonSays and useBubblePop"

- `src/utils/gameUtils.ts`: Added `'clear'` to `SoundEffect` union + its oscillator implementation; added `SOUND_SETTING_KEY`, `getSoundEnabled()`, `setSoundEnabled()`; added early-return guard in `playSound()` that checks `kda:settings:soundEnabled`
- `src/hooks/useSoundSetting.ts` (new): `useSoundSetting()` hook — initialises from storage, returns `{ soundEnabled, toggleSound }` with a stable `useCallback`
- `src/components/shared/GameLayout.tsx`: Imports `useSoundSetting`, calls the hook, renders a `🔊/🔇` button between `headerActions` and the Home button
- `src/hooks/useColorBlocksGame.ts`: Added `playSound('clear')` call in `handleBlockClick` after blocks are removed — the one game that was missing audio feedback

## Verification
- Build: `npm run build` → ✓ 95 modules, 807ms
- Lint: `npm run lint` → ✓ No issues
- Type-check: `tsc --noEmit` → ✓ No errors
- Main tests: `vitest run` → ✓ 133/133
- Games tests: `vitest run --config vitest.games.config.ts` → ✓ 35/35
- Touch tests: `vitest run --config vitest.mobile.config.ts` → ✓ 1/1
- Playwright: `playwright test` → ✓ 6/6

## Summary
All 4 games now have sound and respect a single `kda:settings:soundEnabled` flag (default on). The flag is toggled via a `🔊/🔇` button baked into `GameLayout` — so every current and future game gets it for free. 10 total `playSound` call sites across MemoryMatch, PopBalloons, MathFacts, and ColorBlocks. Standing by for the next task.

{"type":"task_assignment","taskId":"17","subject":"PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo","description":"Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

content.subject: PR-5a1: Pictographic difficulty selectors (7 games)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5a1 (~L213-217). Replace text "Easy / Medium / Hard" difficulty selectors with pictographic icons (🐣/🐱/🦁 or similar age-appropriate animals) across: PopBalloons, SimonSays, MemoryMatch, Snake, MathFacts, ShapeSorting, ColorMixer.

ACTIONS:
1. For each of the 7 games, find the difficulty selector UI in the Page.tsx (or in the in-game settings panel).
2. Replace text labels with emoji/icon buttons. Keep aria-label="Easy"/"Medium"/"Hard" intact for screen readers (this is the gemini critic's measurable acceptance — and good a11y).
3. Use consistent icons across all games: 🐣 (easy / baby chick), 🐱 (medium / cat), 🦁 (hard / lion). Add a "kid-button" Tailwind class for size if needed.

- Per-PR gate green: lint + type-check + test --run + test:games + test:touch + playwright + build

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5c2: ColorMixer proximity thermometer indicator"

content.subject: PR-5d: First-run onboarding overlay
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5d (~L239-241). Pictographic 4-step onboarding overlay shown on first app launch. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs.

ACTIONS:
1. Create src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.tsx. Renders a modal/full-screen overlay with 4 steps:
   - Step 1: 🎮 "Pick a game!" — point to home tiles
   - Step 2: 👆 "Tap to play!" — pictographic demo of tap interaction
   - Step 3: 🌟 "Check today's challenge!" — point to Daily Drawing Prompt
   - Step 4: 🖼️ "Save your art!" — point to drawing → Gallery flow
   Use big emoji + minimal text. Pre-readers should grok it from icons alone.
2. Each step has a "Next →" or "Got it!" button (final). Pre-readers can use emoji icons.
3. Gate visibility on `storage.get('firstRunComplete', false)`. On dismiss (any step's final button), `storage.set('firstRunComplete', true)`.
4. Wire into App.tsx so the overlay renders ABOVE HomePage on first load and never again.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.test.tsx NEW:
   * Mount with `firstRunComplete=false`, assert overlay visible
   * Click through to step 4 and dismiss, assert storage.get('firstRunComplete') === true
   * Re-render with `firstRunComplete=true`, assert overlay NOT in DOM
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5d: first-run onboarding overlay (4-step pictographic)"

Plan v3 PR-5d (~L239-241). Pictographic 4-step onboarding overlay shown on first app launch. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs.

ACTIONS:
1. Create src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.tsx. Renders a modal/full-screen overlay with 4 steps:
   - Step 1: 🎮 "Pick a game!" — point to home tiles
   - Step 2: 👆 "Tap to play!" — pictographic demo of tap interaction
   - Step 3: 🌟 "Check today's challenge!" — point to Daily Drawing Prompt
   - Step 4: 🖼️ "Save your art!" — point to drawing → Gallery flow
   Use big emoji + minimal text. Pre-readers should grok it from icons alone.
2. Each step has a "Next →" or "Got it!" button (final). Pre-readers can use emoji icons.
3. Gate visibility on `storage.get('firstRunComplete', false)`. On dismiss (any step's final button), `storage.set('firstRunComplete', true)`.
4. Wire into App.tsx so the overlay renders ABOVE HomePage on first load and never again.

   * Mount with `firstRunComplete=false`, assert overlay visible
   * Click through to step 4 and dismiss, assert storage.get('firstRunComplete') === true
   * Re-render with `firstRunComplete=true`, assert overlay NOT in DOM
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5a1: Pictographic difficulty selectors (7 games)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5a1 (~L213-217). Replace text "Easy / Medium / Hard" difficulty selectors with pictographic icons (🐣/🐱/🦁 or similar age-appropriate animals) across: PopBalloons, SimonSays, MemoryMatch, Snake, MathFacts, ShapeSorting, ColorMixer.

ACTIONS:
1. For each of the 7 games, find the difficulty selector UI in the Page.tsx (or in the in-game settings panel).
2. Replace text labels with emoji/icon buttons. Keep aria-label="Easy"/"Medium"/"Hard" intact for screen readers (this is the gemini critic's measurable acceptance — and good a11y).
3. Use consistent icons across all games: 🐣 (easy / baby chick), 🐱 (medium / cat), 🦁 (hard / lion). Add a "kid-button" Tailwind class for size if needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- `grep -rE "(>Easy<|>Medium<|>Hard<)" src/components/Games/*/[A-Z]*Page.tsx` returns 0 matches in the difficulty-selector buttons themselves (the visible button text). Aria-labels MAY still contain those words (acceptable).
- All 7 games' difficulty selectors render the 3 emoji buttons (manual check)
- Each emoji has a corresponding aria-label
- Per-PR gate green: lint + type-check + test --run + test:games + test:touch + playwright + build

content.subject: PR-5a2: Win celebrations (3 games)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5a2 (~L219-222). Replace black-overlay game-over modals on Snake, PopBalloons, SimonSays with celebratory pattern. BLOCKED BY #15 (PR-5a1 — same Page.tsx files for Snake/PopBalloons/SimonSays).

ACTIONS:
1. Pick ONE simple approach: either (a) hand-rolled emoji-burst animation using `position: absolute` divs + CSS keyframes already set up in PR-2 BubblePop pattern, or (b) add the `canvas-confetti` npm dep (~5KB minified). Plan v3 explicitly says DO NOT hand-roll a custom particle engine (the architect critic flagged this as risk).
2. For each game's game-over modal: trigger confetti + playSound('victory') (or 'gameover' for lose).
3. Replace the `fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50` with a friendlier pastel + rounded card.

- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

3. Limit to 3 hints per game. Store `hintsUsed` in game state. Show counter near button: "💡 Hint (2/3 left)".
4. Persist hintsUsed in the game's stored state (existing kda:sudoku key) so it survives reloads.

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5d: First-run onboarding overlay
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5d (~L239-241). Pictographic 4-step onboarding overlay shown on first app launch. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs.

ACTIONS:
1. Create src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.tsx. Renders a modal/full-screen overlay with 4 steps:
   - Step 1: 🎮 "Pick a game!" — point to home tiles
   - Step 2: 👆 "Tap to play!" — pictographic demo of tap interaction
   - Step 3: 🌟 "Check today's challenge!" — point to Daily Drawing Prompt
   - Step 4: 🖼️ "Save your art!" — point to drawing → Gallery flow
   Use big emoji + minimal text. Pre-readers should grok it from icons alone.
2. Each step has a "Next →" or "Got it!" button (final). Pre-readers can use emoji icons.
3. Gate visibility on `storage.get('firstRunComplete', false)`. On dismiss (any step's final button), `storage.set('firstRunComplete', true)`.
4. Wire into App.tsx so the overlay renders ABOVE HomePage on first load and never again.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.test.tsx NEW:
   * Mount with `firstRunComplete=false`, assert overlay visible
   * Click through to step 4 and dismiss, assert storage.get('firstRunComplete') === true
   * Re-render with `firstRunComplete=true`, assert overlay NOT in DOM
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   I am "worker-1" in a multi-agent team ("kda-resurrect") implementing a phased resurrection plan for a kids React/TypeScript drawing app. Security/operational constraints that MUST remain in effect:
   - NEVER use git push, git rebase --onto, or any remote-mutating commands
   - NEVER skip pre-commit hooks (--no-verify) unless team-lead explicitly approves
   - NEVER spawn sub-agents (do NOT use Task tool)
   - Do NOT use `npm audit fix --force`
   - Do NOT upgrade React (stay on 18.x)
   - Do NOT upgrade Tailwind (stay on 3.x)
   - Do NOT touch console.log statements (those are Phase 7)

   Team-lead has assigned tasks sequentially. Current assignment is Task #17 (PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo) which is in progress.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS + Vitest 3 + Playwright
   - `useCanvas` hook with canvas history stack using dataURL snapshots (JPEG@0.7)
   - Undo/redo pattern: `historyRef` (past states), `futureRef` (redo states), `pendingSnapshotRef` (pre-stroke capture)
   - `captureSnapshot()` / `applySnapshot()` / `pushHistory()` helpers in useCanvas
   - History cap at 20 frames — oldest evicted when exceeded
   - `useSoundSetting` hook reading/writing `kda:settings:soundEnabled` via storage module
   - `getStatusColor(status, overrides?)` utility in `gameUtils.ts`
   - `GameLayout` shared component with `🔊/🔇` sound toggle and `headerActions` slot
   - `DrawingToolPanel` with undo/redo buttons (disabled when `canUndo`/`canRedo` false)
   - Multi-config Vitest: main / vitest.games.config.ts / vitest.mobile.config.ts
   - Canvas testing with jsdom: mock `HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext`, `toDataURL`, synchronous `MockImage` class
   - Test pattern: `render` + component harness (`CanvasHarness`) so canvasRef is attached; read state via `handle.current!` (NOT stale captured `hook`) after re-renders

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **src/utils/gameUtils.ts**:
     - Added `getStatusColor(status, overrides?)` with DEFAULT_STATUS_COLORS map
     - Added `'clear'` to SoundEffect union with high-to-low sweeping oscillator
     - Added `SOUND_SETTING_KEY = 'settings:soundEnabled'`
     - Added `getSoundEnabled()` and `setSoundEnabled(enabled)` backed by storage
     - Modified `playSound()` to early-return if `!getSoundEnabled()`

   - **src/hooks/useSoundSetting.ts** (NEW):
     ```ts
     export function useSoundSetting() {
       const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabledState] = useState<boolean>(getSoundEnabled);
       const toggleSound = useCallback(() => {
         setSoundEnabledState(prev => { const next = !prev; setSoundEnabled(next); return next; });
       }, []);
       return { soundEnabled, toggleSound };
     }
     ```

   - **src/components/shared/GameLayout.tsx**:
     - Added `useSoundSetting` import
     - Added `const { soundEnabled, toggleSound } = useSoundSetting();`
     - Added `🔊/🔇` toggle button in header (between headerActions and Home button)
     - Home button has `aria-label="← Home"` for Playwright accessibility

   - **src/hooks/useColorBlocksGame.ts**:
     - Added `import { playSound } from '../utils/gameUtils';`
     - Added `playSound('clear')` in `handleBlockClick` after block removal

   - **src/hooks/useCanvas.ts** (major changes for PR-5b):
     ```ts
     // Added after stateRef:
     const MAX_HISTORY = 20;
     const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
     const futureRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
     const pendingSnapshotRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
     const prevStencilRef = useRef<Stencil | null | undefined>(undefined);
     const [canUndo, setCanUndo] = useState(false);
     const [canRedo, setCanRedo] = useState(false);
     ```
     - Added `captureSnapshot()`, `applySnapshot()`, `pushHistory()`, `undo()`, `redo()` callbacks
     - Added stencil-tracking `useEffect` (BEFORE init effect) watching `[stencil]`
     - Modified `startDrawing` to capture `pendingSnapshotRef.current = captureSnapshot()` before brush strokes
     - Modified `stopDrawing` to call `pushHistory(pendingSnapshotRef.current)` after path commits
     - Modified `clearCanvas` and `floodFill` to push to history before destructive operations
     - Updated return object to include `undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo`

   - **src/components/Tools/DrawingToolPanel.tsx**:
     - Added optional props: `onUndo?`, `onRedo?`, `canUndo? = false`, `canRedo? = false`
     - Added ↩️ Undo / ↪️ Redo buttons in both desktop action row and mobile top bar
     - Buttons are `disabled={!canUndo}` / `disabled={!canRedo}` with `disabled:opacity-40`

   - **src/components/Canvas/DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx**:
     - Destructured `undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo` from `useCanvas` return
     - Passed all four to both `DrawingToolPanel` instances via `replace_all` (both mobile and desktop)

   - **src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts** (NEW):
     ```ts
     // SyncImage fires onload synchronously when src is set
     class SyncImage { set src(_) { this.onload?.(); } }
     
     // Wrapper that attaches canvasRef to real DOM canvas
     function CanvasHarness({ handle, stencil = null }) {
       const hook = useCanvas({ width: 100, height: 100, stencil });
       handle.current = hook; // updated on every re-render
       return React.createElement('canvas', { ref: hook.canvasRef });
     }
     
     // simulateStroke reads from handle.current! (not stale captured hook)
     function simulateStroke(handle) {
       act(() => { handle.current!.startDrawing(mouseEvent(10,10)); });
       act(() => { handle.current!.draw(mouseEvent(20,20)); });
       act(() => { handle.current!.stopDrawing(mouseEvent(20,20)); });
     }
     ```
     Tests: "undo after clear", "undo during stencil overlay", "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history", "history capped at 20"
     All 4 pass.

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **"File has not been read yet" on Edit**: Attempted to edit `gameUtils.ts` using only `cat` (Bash) to read it. Fix: must use the Read tool before editing.
   - **useCanvas test failures (canUndo always false)**: `const hook = handle.current!` captured the initial render's return value — `hook.canUndo` was always false even after state updates. Root cause: React returns a new object on each render; the captured `hook` doesn't update. Fix: always read state via `handle.current!.canUndo` (updated on every re-render by `handle.current = hook` in CanvasHarness). Changed `simulateStroke` to accept `handle` parameter (not `hook`) and read all functions from `handle.current!`.
   - **Lint: 4 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings in useCanvas.ts**: Calling `captureSnapshot` and `pushHistory` inside `floodFill` (line 504), `startDrawing` (line 537), `stopDrawing` (line 595), `clearCanvas` (line 624) without listing them in dependency arrays. Fix in progress: add `captureSnapshot` and/or `pushHistory` to each callback's deps array (safe since both are `useCallback` with `[]` stable deps).

5. Problem Solving:
   - Solved sound gating: modified `playSound()` itself to check `storage.get('settings:soundEnabled', true)` on each call — all 10 existing callers automatically respect the flag with zero changes to their call sites
   - Solved stencil undo: separate `useEffect` watching `[stencil]` fires BEFORE the init effect (same render cycle, effects run in declaration order), capturing the pre-stencil canvas state before the init effect clears and redraws with new stencil
   - Solved pre-stroke capture: `pendingSnapshotRef` captures canvas state in `startDrawing` (before pixels drawn), pushed to history only in `stopDrawing` (after confirming path.length > 0)
   - Pre-existing test failure: `useWinCelebration.test.ts` fails with "Cannot access mockConfetti before initialization" — this is worker-2's Task #16 (PR-5a2), NOT caused by my changes

**9404** " ✅ **PR-4b1 and PR-4b2: Game Utilities Extraction and Sound Toggle Integration Verified**
PR-4b1 and PR-4b2 are functionally integrated and verified. getStatusColor is defined once in gameUtils.ts with a DEFAULT_STATUS_COLORS record mapping status strings to Tailwind text-color classes. Games override individual statuses via optional parameter (MemoryMatch overrides 'playing' to purple). playSound is wired with a guard clause that checks getSoundEnabled() before synthesis; users control sound via GameLayout's 🔊/🔇 header button. Sound setting persists to localStorage via useSoundSetting hook, defaulting to true (enabled). The 'clear' sound type is implemented and ready for games that call playSound('clear') on block clear (e.g., ColorBlocks).
~398t 🛠️ 11,907

**9406** " ✅ **PR-4c1: usePopBalloons Refactored to useReducer with Stale-Closure Combo Bug Fixed**
PR-4c1 successfully collapsed usePopBalloons from 12+ useState calls into a single useReducer with a pure balloonReducer function. The refactoring exposed and fixed a latent stale-closure bug in combo calculation: the pre-refactored code likely computed combo using a stale closure over combo state, while the refactored version reads fresh combo from reducer state. The fix is validated by test cases that explicitly verify combo increments within COMBO_WINDOW and resets when outside it; these tests would fail if the code reverted to the stale-closure pattern. The reducer publishes InternalState with lastPopTime tracking, and the public API (gameState, callbacks) remains unchanged. Side-effects (playSound calls on balloon pop) execute before dispatch, keeping the reducer pure and testable.
~546t 🛠️ 15,846

**9407** 6:24a ✅ **PR-4c2 and PR-4c3: Animation Frame and Timeout Cleanup Optimizations**
PR-4c2 optimizes useBubblePop animation loop by ensuring ONE setGameState per rAF frame (not two) and preventing loop restart on bubble spawn. The key fix is removing bubbles.length from dependency array and reading bubble count from prev state inside the functional update instead. Test validates ~60 frames/sec and confirms cancelAnimationFrame is never called mid-gameplay (which was the bug). Pop animation timeouts are tracked in an array and all cleared on unmount, preventing stale setState leaks. PR-4c3 fixes useSimonSays showSequence by tracking all three levels of nested timeout IDs in a ref array instead of a single timeout that was overwritten each iteration. The bug manifested as all but the last button being cancelled in a multi-step sequence display. Cleanup useEffect and resetGame both clear all tracked timeouts, and tests validate no warnings on unmount and complete sequence display across rounds.
~555t 🛠️ 13,269

**9408** " 🔵 **Phase 4 Verification Complete: All 6 PRs Pass Acceptance Criteria**
Phase 4 (Architecture wins) verification is complete with a full PASS verdict. All 6 PRs meet or exceed acceptance criteria. The GameLayout standardization (PR-4a) unified all 13 games on a shared wrapper, reducing maintenance from O(n) to O(1). Game utility extraction (PR-4b1) eliminated getStatusColor duplication. Sound toggle (PR-4b2) integrated cleanly into GameLayout, defaulting to enabled. The PopBalloons refactor to useReducer (PR-4c1) surfaced a latent stale-closure bug in combo logic, which is now prevented by the reducer pattern and verified by dedicated tests. Animation loop optimization (PR-4c2) ensures exactly one state update per rAF frame by reading bubble count from prev state rather than deps. Timeout cleanup (PR-4c3) fixed a critical SimonSays bug where sequence steps were being cancelled mid-display due to forEach overwriting the ref. All bug fixes are locked in by named tests that would fail if the code reverted to pre-refactored patterns. Test suite is comprehensive (23+ reducer tests, rAF timing tests, timeout cleanup tests) and all CI gates pass. The phase is ready to advance to Phase 5.

content.description:

2. Replace text labels with emoji/icon buttons. Keep aria-label="Easy"/"Medium"/"Hard" intact for screen readers (this is the gemini critic's measurable acceptance — and good a11y).
3. Use consistent icons across all games: 🐣 (easy / baby chick), 🐱 (medium / cat), 🦁 (hard / lion). Add a "kid-button" Tailwind class for size if needed.

- `grep -rE "(>Easy<|>Medium<|>Hard<)" src/components/Games/*/[A-Z]*Page.tsx` returns 0 matches in the difficulty-selector buttons themselves (the visible button text). Aria-labels MAY still contain those words (acceptable).

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5d: First-run onboarding overlay
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5d (~L239-241). Pictographic 4-step onboarding overlay shown on first app launch. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs.

ACTIONS:
1. Create src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.tsx. Renders a modal/full-screen overlay with 4 steps:
   - Step 1: 🎮 "Pick a game!" — point to home tiles
   - Step 2: 👆 "Tap to play!" — pictographic demo of tap interaction
   - Step 3: 🌟 "Check today's challenge!" — point to Daily Drawing Prompt
   - Step 4: 🖼️ "Save your art!" — point to drawing → Gallery flow
   Use big emoji + minimal text. Pre-readers should grok it from icons alone.
2. Each step has a "Next →" or "Got it!" button (final). Pre-readers can use emoji icons.
3. Gate visibility on `storage.get('firstRunComplete', false)`. On dismiss (any step's final button), `storage.set('firstRunComplete', true)`.
4. Wire into App.tsx so the overlay renders ABOVE HomePage on first load and never again.

ACCEPTANCE:

   * Mount with `firstRunComplete=false`, assert overlay visible

   * Re-render with `firstRunComplete=true`, assert overlay NOT in DOM
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5a1: Pictographic difficulty selectors (7 games)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5a1 (~L213-217). Replace text "Easy / Medium / Hard" difficulty selectors with pictographic icons (🐣/🐱/🦁 or similar age-appropriate animals) across: PopBalloons, SimonSays, MemoryMatch, Snake, MathFacts, ShapeSorting, ColorMixer.

ACTIONS:
1. For each of the 7 games, find the difficulty selector UI in the Page.tsx (or in the in-game settings panel).
2. Replace text labels with emoji/icon buttons. Keep aria-label="Easy"/"Medium"/"Hard" intact for screen readers (this is the gemini critic's measurable acceptance — and good a11y).
3. Use consistent icons across all games: 🐣 (easy / baby chick), 🐱 (medium / cat), 🦁 (hard / lion). Add a "kid-button" Tailwind class for size if needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- `grep -rE "(>Easy<|>Medium<|>Hard<)" src/components/Games/*/[A-Z]*Page.tsx` returns 0 matches in the difficulty-selector buttons themselves (the visible button text). Aria-labels MAY still contain those words (acceptable).
- All 7 games' difficulty selectors render the 3 emoji buttons (manual check)
- Each emoji has a corresponding aria-label
- Per-PR gate green: lint + type-check + test --run + test:games + test:touch + playwright + build

content.subject: PR-5a2: Win celebrations (3 games)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5a2 (~L219-222). Replace black-overlay game-over modals on Snake, PopBalloons, SimonSays with celebratory pattern. BLOCKED BY #15 (PR-5a1 — same Page.tsx files for Snake/PopBalloons/SimonSays).

ACTIONS:
1. Pick ONE simple approach: either (a) hand-rolled emoji-burst animation using `position: absolute` divs + CSS keyframes already set up in PR-2 BubblePop pattern, or (b) add the `canvas-confetti` npm dep (~5KB minified). Plan v3 explicitly says DO NOT hand-roll a custom particle engine (the architect critic flagged this as risk).
2. For each game's game-over modal: trigger confetti + playSound('victory') (or 'gameover' for lose).
3. Replace the `fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50` with a friendlier pastel + rounded card.

- A NEW test file (per-game or shared) asserts the celebration mounts/unmounts cleanly (no leaked confetti DOM nodes after game-over modal closes)
- On a 360px DevTools viewport, animation runs at ≥30 FPS (manual sample; OK to verify once and note in PR description)
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

3. Limit to 3 hints per game. Store `hintsUsed` in game state. Show counter near button: "💡 Hint (2/3 left)".
4. Persist hintsUsed in the game's stored state (existing kda:sudoku key) so it survives reloads.

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5c2: ColorMixer proximity thermometer indicator"

content.subject: PR-5d: First-run onboarding overlay
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5d (~L239-241). Pictographic 4-step onboarding overlay shown on first app launch. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs.

ACTIONS:
1. Create src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.tsx. Renders a modal/full-screen overlay with 4 steps:
   - Step 1: 🎮 "Pick a game!" — point to home tiles
   - Step 2: 👆 "Tap to play!" — pictographic demo of tap interaction
   - Step 3: 🌟 "Check today's challenge!" — point to Daily Drawing Prompt
   - Step 4: 🖼️ "Save your art!" — point to drawing → Gallery flow
   Use big emoji + minimal text. Pre-readers should grok it from icons alone.
2. Each step has a "Next →" or "Got it!" button (final). Pre-readers can use emoji icons.
3. Gate visibility on `storage.get('firstRunComplete', false)`. On dismiss (any step's final button), `storage.set('firstRunComplete', true)`.
4. Wire into App.tsx so the overlay renders ABOVE HomePage on first load and never again.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.test.tsx NEW:
   * Mount with `firstRunComplete=false`, assert overlay visible
   * Click through to step 4 and dismiss, assert storage.get('firstRunComplete') === true
   * Re-render with `firstRunComplete=true`, assert overlay NOT in DOM
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5d: first-run onboarding overlay (4-step pictographic)"

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

content.description:

content.subject: PR-5a1: Pictographic difficulty selectors (7 games)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5a1 (~L213-217). Replace text "Easy / Medium / Hard" difficulty selectors with pictographic icons (🐣/🐱/🦁 or similar age-appropriate animals) across: PopBalloons, SimonSays, MemoryMatch, Snake, MathFacts, ShapeSorting, ColorMixer.

2. Replace text labels with emoji/icon buttons. Keep aria-label="Easy"/"Medium"/"Hard" intact for screen readers (this is the gemini critic's measurable acceptance — and good a11y).
3. Use consistent icons across all games: 🐣 (easy / baby chick), 🐱 (medium / cat), 🦁 (hard / lion). Add a "kid-button" Tailwind class for size if needed.

- `grep -rE "(>Easy<|>Medium<|>Hard<)" src/components/Games/*/[A-Z]*Page.tsx` returns 0 matches in the difficulty-selector buttons themselves (the visible button text). Aria-labels MAY still contain those words (acceptable).

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

4. Persist hintsUsed in the game's stored state (existing kda:sudoku key) so it survives reloads.

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).

   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5d: First-run onboarding overlay
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5d (~L239-241). Pictographic 4-step onboarding overlay shown on first app launch. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs.

ACTIONS:
1. Create src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.tsx. Renders a modal/full-screen overlay with 4 steps:
   - Step 1: 🎮 "Pick a game!" — point to home tiles
   - Step 2: 👆 "Tap to play!" — pictographic demo of tap interaction
   - Step 3: 🌟 "Check today's challenge!" — point to Daily Drawing Prompt
   - Step 4: 🖼️ "Save your art!" — point to drawing → Gallery flow
   Use big emoji + minimal text. Pre-readers should grok it from icons alone.
2. Each step has a "Next →" or "Got it!" button (final). Pre-readers can use emoji icons.
3. Gate visibility on `storage.get('firstRunComplete', false)`. On dismiss (any step's final button), `storage.set('firstRunComplete', true)`.
4. Wire into App.tsx so the overlay renders ABOVE HomePage on first load and never again.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.test.tsx NEW:
   * Mount with `firstRunComplete=false`, assert overlay visible
   * Click through to step 4 and dismiss, assert storage.get('firstRunComplete') === true
   * Re-render with `firstRunComplete=true`, assert overlay NOT in DOM
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-5c1: Sudoku hint
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c1 (~L232-234). Add hint feature to Sudoku. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Add a "💡 Hint" button to SudokuPage.tsx header (in `headerActions` slot of GameLayout).
2. On click: find one empty cell, look up its solution value from the puzzle's solution, briefly highlight it (border or pulse animation), reveal the digit for ~3 sec before fading.
3. Limit to 3 hints per game. Store `hintsUsed` in game state. Show counter near button: "💡 Hint (2/3 left)".
4. Persist hintsUsed in the game's stored state (existing kda:sudoku key) so it survives reloads.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useSudokuGame.test.ts NEW or extended:
   * "hint returns coordinate matching solution" — call hint, assert returned cell value equals solution[cell]
   * "hint counter caps at 3" — call 4× in a row, assert 4th is no-op
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5d: First-run onboarding overlay
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5d (~L239-241). Pictographic 4-step onboarding overlay shown on first app launch. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs.

ACTIONS:
1. Create src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.tsx. Renders a modal/full-screen overlay with 4 steps:
   - Step 1: 🎮 "Pick a game!" — point to home tiles
   - Step 2: 👆 "Tap to play!" — pictographic demo of tap interaction
   - Step 3: 🌟 "Check today's challenge!" — point to Daily Drawing Prompt
   - Step 4: 🖼️ "Save your art!" — point to drawing → Gallery flow
   Use big emoji + minimal text. Pre-readers should grok it from icons alone.
2. Each step has a "Next →" or "Got it!" button (final). Pre-readers can use emoji icons.
3. Gate visibility on `storage.get('firstRunComplete', false)`. On dismiss (any step's final button), `storage.set('firstRunComplete', true)`.
4. Wire into App.tsx so the overlay renders ABOVE HomePage on first load and never again.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.test.tsx NEW:
   * Mount with `firstRunComplete=false`, assert overlay visible
   * Click through to step 4 and dismiss, assert storage.get('firstRunComplete') === true
   * Re-render with `firstRunComplete=true`, assert overlay NOT in DOM
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.
